A vulnerability was identified in Cockpit-HQ Cockpit up to 2.14.1. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file cron.php of the component Web Worker. Such manipulation of the argument token leads to missing authentication. The attack can be executed remotely. The attack requires a high level of complexity. The exploitation is known to be difficult. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. Web-Token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.10, 4.0.0 before 4.0.7, and 4.1.0 before 4.1.7 contain an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in PBES2AESKW::unwrapKey(), which passes the attacker-controlled p2c JWE header value to hash_pbkdf2() without an upper bound.
